RiverConnectionDownstreamOffsetDescripti:
How many blocks downstream along the river centerline the stream mouth connection point is moved.
This makes the connections streams that join rivers run downstream the river, not against it.
RiverDrainFadeOffsetDescription:
How far away the fade circle is from the stream mouth at river drain connections.
Uses a gradient circle to fade out the stream mouth into the river.
RiverDrainFadeRadiusDescription:
How big the fade circle is at river drain connections.
Uses a gradient circle to fade out the stream mouth into the river.>
MinRiverWidthForStreamDrainDescription:
Minimum river channel width in blocks at the connection point for a stream to drain into the river.
This makes sure big+wide streams dont flow into thin river sources.
